question: Mohammad Yunus established which of the following banks in 1983?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Grameen Bank**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Grameen Bank** was established by **Mohammad Yunus in 1983**.
 
• It is a microfinance organization and community development bank founded in **Bangladesh**.
 
• Grameen Bank makes **small loans (known as microcredit or "Grameencredit")** to the impoverished without requiring collateral.
 
• The bank and its founder, Mohammad Yunus, were awarded the **Nobel Peace Prize in 2006** for their efforts to create economic and social development from below.
 
• The model of microfinance pioneered by Grameen Bank has been replicated in many countries around the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Microfinance** is a type of **banking service** that is **provided to unemployed or low-income individuals or groups** who otherwise would have no other access to financial services.
 
• Microfinance allows people to take on reasonable small business loans safely, and in a manner that is consistent with ethical lending practices.
 
• Grameen Bank's approach is based on the idea that the poor have skills that are underutilized and that financial capital can help them to leverage these skills to improve their economic conditions.
 
• Mohammad Yunus's vision was to eradicate poverty through entrepreneurship and self-sustaining business practices among the poor.
